official.description_text:
Researcher in systems biology of photosynthesis
Apply for position
KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Engineering Sciences in Chemistry, Biotechnology and Health
Job description
The researcher will also be responsible for design and execution of systems biology experiments involving cyanobacteria and plant systems. This entails development and application of interaction proteomics methods, maintenance and optimization of mass-spectrometry equipment, analysis of proteomics data. The researcher will also be responsible for training other lab members in liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry
Qualifications
Requirements
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree
Previous experience designing and executing mass-spectrometry based proteomics experiments
Preferred qualifications
Previous experience in cultivation of cyanobacteria
Demonstrated independence in design and execution of experiments·
Demonstrated ability for collaboration
Knowledge of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality
Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH

To apply for the position
Log into KTH's recruitment system in order to apply for this position. You are responsible to ensure that your application is complete according to the instructions in the ad.
The application must include:
CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
Copy of diplomas and grades from your previous university studies. Translations into English or Swedish if the original documents have not been issued in any of these languages.
Brief account of why you want to conduct research, your academic interests and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals. Max one page long.
Your complete application must be received by KTH no later than the last day of application, midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
About the employment
The employment is valid for a limited time according to the agreement - for up to 2 months, with access according to agreement.

ai.summary: A fixed-term researcher position at KTH focusing on systems biology of photosynthesis, involving design and execution of mass-spectrometry-based proteomics experiments with cyanobacteria and plant systems, including equipment maintenance and lab training responsibilities.

thematic_fit.rationale: No overlap between immersive systems, spatial cognition, collaborative learning, and HCI on one hand, and systems biology, photosynthesis, proteomics, and mass spectrometry on the other. The domains are entirely orthogonal.

methodological_fit.rationale: Both involve experimental design and lab-based work, but the researcher's methodological expertise is in HCI user studies, immersive systems evaluation, and spatial cognition measurement. This position requires wet-lab proteomics methods, mass-spectrometry operation, and biochemistry knowledge—fundamentally different experimental contexts. The shared methodological language (experimental design) does not transfer to the specific technical execution required.

growth_value.rationale: This position closes no capability gaps relevant to the researcher's target identity. It would require building entirely new technical expertise in biochemistry, analytical chemistry, and proteomics, while diverting from the human-centred immersive systems research trajectory they are pursuing.

strategic_value.rationale: KTH is a strong institution and Stockholm is in Europe (preferred geography), which adds minor positive signals. However, the research group is systems biology, not HCI or immersive systems. This position does not advance the researcher toward doctoral positions in human-centred XR, nor does it build a coherent research narrative for PhD applications to target institutions like Aalto or TU Delft.

eligibility_flags: Position requires a completed doctoral degree; researcher holds MSc by Research (in progress). Eligibility depends on thesis completion timeline and position start date.
Position is fixed-term (up to 2 months) with limited full-time capacity—insufficient duration for meaningful research contribution or career development.
risks: Fundamental domain mismatch (biology/proteomics vs. HCI/immersive systems) makes this a career detour rather than progression.
Two-month contract is too short for onboarding in a wet-lab environment or contributing publishable research.
No publications or research output would be credible to target PhD programs (Aalto, TU Delft) if the researcher diverges into systems biology.
Takes researcher away from consolidating their XR research portfolio during a critical thesis-completion period.
Requires completion of doctoral degree before eligible; no pathway to PhD candidacy in the researcher's target field.
